description: This file contains the PHP class 'Ip' which is part of the OpenCart admin module for managing fraud-related IP addresses, including methods for install/uninstall, adding, removing, and retrieving IP records from the database.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing fraud IP addresses within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'fraud_ip' table in the database to store IP addresses involved in fraud.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'fraud_ip' table from the database.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the fraud list.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the fraud list.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of stored IP addresses with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Returns the total number of IP addresses in the database.

methods.name: getTotalIpsByIp
methods.description: Returns the total count of entries for a specific IP address.
